name: Credibility
description: Trust-building section with five proof formats: certificate logo grid, guarantee icon cards, a 4-KPI stats banner, awards (one featured + list), or customer reviews as a star grid or horizontal slider. Each variant reads its own collection.
when_to_use: Mid or lower page to back up claims with third-party proof — certifications, guarantees, awards, review scores. Use Testimonials for narrative customer quotes; use Stats for company KPIs without a trust framing.
capabilities: certificate grid with logo, issuer, and 'since' year
guarantee cards with preset icons (shield, clock, euro, handshake)
stats banner with value + suffix + label KPIs
awards list with a featured hero card (featured flag)
reviews with star ratings, aggregate summary (average, count, sources), grid or arrow-paged slider

variants.description: Logo grid from certificates[] with name, issuer, since year. Default.
KPI banner from stats[] ({ value, suffix, label }).
Awards from awards[]; the featured flag renders one as the hero card.
Star-rated review cards in a grid, with summary row (avg, count, sources).
Same review cards in a horizontally paged slider with prev/next arrows.

breakpoints.mobile: Grids collapse to 1-2 columns; the reviews slider pages one card at a time.
breakpoints.desktop: Multi-column grids; stats banner in a single row.

Icon.none: icon; always drawn (guarantees[].icon only picks the glyph, defaults to shield)

Award Meta.none: not modelled: featured-card-only meta; awards[].year/project also feed the list rows, which the design keeps

Stars.none: stars always drawn (reviews[].rating falls back to 5)

cred-cert-logo-text.none: derived: initials of the name when no logo

since.none: display-formatted ("seit 2014"); certificates[].since stores the year as a Number

cred-award-row-year.none: award rows are awards[1..] (awards[0] is the featured card); [] cannot offset

cred-award-row-title.none: award rows are awards[1..] (awards[0] is the featured card); [] cannot offset

project.none: award rows are awards[1..] (awards[0] is the featured card); [] cannot offset

suffix.none: suffix node is missing on stats without one, so values do not align with stats[] by index

ai.prompt_summary: Credibility: trust/proof section. Settings: variant (certificates|guarantees|stats-banner|awards|reviews|reviews-slider), eyebrow, headline, intro. Per variant: certificates[] { name (required), description, issuer, since (year), logo }; guarantees[] { icon (shield|clock|euro|handshake), title, description }; stats[] { value, suffix, label }; awards[] { year, title, project, issuer, featured }; reviews variants: reviews_summary_avg, reviews_summary_count, reviews_summary_source plus reviews[] { name (required), project, rating (0-5), quote, date, source }.
ai.content_guidelines: 4-8 items per collection. Review quotes 1-3 sentences, ratings mostly 4-5. Use realistic issuers/sources (TÜV, Google, Trustpilot). Exactly one featured award.

field_hints.reviews_summary_avg: Display string with locale decimal comma, e.g. '4,9'.
field_hints.guarantees.icon: Only the four preset values are supported — no free Iconify names here.
field_hints.awards.featured: Set on one award; it renders as the large hero card.
